LM_UNDERSTAND-LOGS: COMPLETE FILE REFERENCE
Repository: https://github.com/RikiyaT/lm_understand-logs
Inspected revision: 4d09ba6d6a7e891dd8063974dfe81b3d78e3494f
Coverage: 8,097 tracked files, including all eight experiment folders and root/harness files.

How to use: search for a complete path or filename. Each entry gives its purpose, actual file size, observed structure and a revision-pinned source link.
Roles are based on repository documentation, script contents and representative run records. Every file was inventoried and its schema/array headers inspected; this is not a claim to have independently verified every scientific interpretation or rerun the experiments.
Exploratory work-note roles inferred from names/fields are marked as such. A schema lists stored fields, not proof that an analysis succeeded.
NumPy dtype notation: <f4=float32, <f8=float64, <f2=float16, <i4=int32, <u2=uint16; <U is a Unicode string array. Experiment 8 uses uint16 to store bfloat16 bit patterns.
Repeated turn folders are chronological observations. A turn, a Python run, a request and a successful forward pass are different counters.
audit.tool_free concerns native Codex tools; externally executed Python/attention/forward calls are preserved separately in tool_calls.jsonl.
Run-record token usage may accumulate over a resumed conversation. Do not sum those cumulative counts across turns.
Large intermediates and some base/checkpoint weights were omitted by the repository authors; paths mentioned inside logs are not necessarily distributed files.

File counts: LICENSE: 1; README.md: 1; exp1_which_game: 43; exp2_diffusion: 36; exp3_language: 319; exp4_fix_car: 15; exp5_write_from_scratch: 36; exp6_go_from_scratch: 1,472; exp7_sycophancy: 1,899; exp8_math: 4,272; harness: 3
